note: ORPHAN Pro 19:24 — the sluggard buries his hand in the dish and will not bring it back to his mouth.

dims.v: paralysing sloth — laziness too great even to lift food to the mouth

the sluggard who buries his hand in the dish and will not even bring it back to his mouth — sloth so total it will not complete the simplest act for its own benefit, laziness that starves rather than stir
the laziness that will not finish even the act of feeding itself

atsel (sluggard) — 'the SLUGGARD buries his hand in the dish and will not even bring it back to his mouth' (19:24; cf 26:15); sloth grown so absolute it will not lift food to feed itself. The lazy man would sooner starve than stir.
